candidate.headline: One sudden mood shift makes the usual plan feel confining.
candidate.body: Notice the first urge to clear your schedule, and move one commitment before you cancel anything. You are halfway through answering work messages when another reminder arrives, and you may suddenly resent every remaining item on the schedule. If you cancel everything, you still have to send explanations and remake the plan. You add more work. You can revise the next few hours before deciding the entire plan is unworkable.

candidate.headline: Sticking to the plan through a sudden mood change makes every commitment feel restrictive.
candidate.body: Notice when you start rejecting a routine you were following without trouble. candidate.body: Watch for the moment you may feel trapped by a plan you chose earlier. Halfway through a familiar work block, you close the document and start rewriting the whole afternoon. You still have the option to keep the deadline, move one lower-stakes task, and use the revised plan for the next few hours.
